We have reached an agreement in principle for Sam Altman to return to OpenAI as CEO with a new initial board of Bret Taylor (Chair), Larry Summers, and Adam D'Angelo.

We are collaborating to figure out the details. Thank you so much for your patience through this.

author: bobmcgrewai
text: OpenAI is nothing without its people

author: bobmcgrewai
text: We're also open-sourcing a new version of Whisper, our ASR model, and the Consistency Decoder, a drop-in replacement for the Stable Diffusion VAE decoder.

author: bobmcgrewai
text: Excited to announce GPT-4 Turbo - a new model with longer context and fresher knowledge than GPT-4, priced at much lower cost!

quoted.text:
